prompt:
Write a first-person account (about 120 words) by the driver for an insurance claim form. Accident: hit while turning left in Pearland, Texas. Injury: whiplash. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1226; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The claimant's account changed in important ways between conversations: the direction of the impact and the number of people in the car are now different.
- The driver is named on the policy.
text: I was turning left at an intersection in Pearland, Texas, when another vehicle struck the side of my car. I have been having neck pain and stiffness since the collision, and my doctor has diagnosed whiplash. I am the named driver on the policy and I was the only person I remember being in the car, though I have since been asked about this and my recollection of the impact direction has shifted somewhat as I think back over what happened. I want to be accurate about these details, so I am sharing what I can now. I have kept the repair estimate, photos of my vehicle, and my medical notes, and I am willing to provide anything else the adjuster needs to review the claim.
